title: Voice Transcript Schema
description: Standard structure for storing speech-to-text transcripts from AI HR screening conversations.

transcript_id.description: Unique identifier for this transcript record.

job_id.description: Identifier of the job being screened for.

question_id.description: Identifier of the HR screening question.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format, for example 2026-10-26T11:45:00Z.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag, such as en or ml-IN.

transcript_text.description: Normalized text recognized from the candidate's speech.

confidence.description: Speech recognition confidence score from 0 to 1, supplied by the speech recognition system.

segments.description: Optional ordered segments with timing and recognition metadata.

normalization_version.description: Version of the transcript normalization rules applied.
